model_identifier_origin: explicit user instruction, 2026-10-02; requested provider alias, availability unverified

arms.E0: direct extraction under shared v2 schema
arms.E1: same schema/input plus fixed relation, condition, polarity and full-page completeness checks

comparison_scope: joint instruction-package effect; not a single-factor causal attribution and not an exact reproduction of the historical v4 extractor
sampling: purposefully selected previously read development pages; no representative-corpus inference
reference_quality: 85 provisional AI primary-core reference items; 18 auxiliary/unresolved; six-page completeness and expert review pending

evaluation.unit: source-relative scoped conditional atomic assertion; duplicate equivalent facts count once
evaluation.match: same page, directed relation, compatible endpoint meaning, complete relevant conditions/modality/polarity/applicability; explicit adjudicated one-to-one matching
evaluation.primary_target_empty_page: MP002:p0089; reference recall NA; primary false fills reported as counts
evaluation.pending: separate from correct/incorrect and matched/missing; no silent exclusion
reports: tokens, latency, returned model, finish reason, parse status
evaluation.provisional_progress_rule: on paired AI technical review only: more unique condition-complete reference matches, no increase in incorrect outputs or background-to-primary outputs, and no loss on any previously covered page; unresolved comparisons remain inconclusive
evaluation.formal_metrics_gate: independent human source-first page inventory + separately adjudicated output correctness/matching + reference completeness required; no formal accuracy/recall now
evaluation.generalization: pilot cannot establish population accuracy/recall or statistical significance even after review

stop_rules: any prior uncertain/failed request: stop, no automatic repeated billable call
non-stop/truncated/invalid JSON: archive raw bytes and stop
returned model mismatch across requests: archive and stop
no model fallback, no prompt tuning, no main-graph writes
reviewer_independence: model opinions and this assistant are not domain experts; runtime publication is still automated, independent review evaluates the study only
